title: Apertus – Open Foundation Model for Sovereign AI
summary: Apertus is an open-source foundation model project designed to enable sovereign AI capabilities, allowing organizations and nations to build and deploy their own AI infrastructure without dependence on closed-source providers. The project addresses growing concerns about data sovereignty and AI independence.
problem_solved: Enables organizations to have full control over their AI infrastructure instead of relying on proprietary AI services from tech giants.
why_valuable: Provides a credible open-source alternative for building sovereign AI systems, addressing critical needs for data privacy, regulatory compliance, and technological independence.
